qualification: DRAFT: retained scoring reports semantic failures; final factual correction has offline/native evidence only. No production or complete business acceptance.
bq030Note: Original UNSUPPORTED oracle retained. The request says only currently approved arrangements, while native calculation includes APPROVED and CHECKED_OUT. All six new LOCATE results remain failures under the frozen oracle. The fixture has no occupied tomorrow interval, so matching IDs and quantities alone cannot settle the intended status restriction. Final prompt states actual computation and preserves requests to change it as unsupported/ambiguous; it has not been externally regenerated.
nativeReplayNote: Product parses supplier raw bodies and reads H2 facts after simulated confirmation. Live HTTPS collection used exact native payloads with diagnostic 60s timeout, not the product 15s timer. All 186 new responses arrived within 15s. Final offline replay substitutes only the final prompt text in payload equivalence checks, retaining metadata, wire schema, user text and provider parameters.
